summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield threw for 381 yards and four touchdowns on 22-of-28 passing in a 34-20 Week 15 win at Green Bay, keeping Tampa Bay atop the NFC South. He posted a perfect 158.3 passer rating and made Lambeau Field and NFL history, adding to a career resurgence after looking to be near the end as a starter a year earlier. Chris Godwin led the receivers with 10 catches for 155 yards.
one_line: Baker Mayfield threw for 381 yards and four TDs with a perfect passer rating as the Buccaneers beat the Packers 34-20 in Week 15.
key_facts: The Buccaneers beat the Packers 34-20 at Lambeau Field in Week 15, keeping Tampa Bay atop the NFC South.
Baker Mayfield completed 22 of 28 passes (78.6%) for 381 yards and four touchdowns with no interceptions.
Entering the game, Mayfield had a hair under 3,000 yards and 20 touchdowns to eight interceptions.
Per ESPN Stats and Info, Mayfield is the sixth visiting QB to throw for at least 350 yards and four TDs at Lambeau Field; Kirk Cousins (2018) was the last.
Mayfield recorded a 158.3 perfect passer rating, the first visiting quarterback ever to do so at Lambeau.
Mayfield is the third QB in NFL history with 375+ passing yards, 4+ TD passes and a 158.3 rating in a road game, joining Nick Foles (2014) and Ken O'Brien (1986).
Against zone coverage, Mayfield went 20-of-24 for 361 yards and three touchdowns, per Next Gen Stats.
Mayfield became the first player in seven years to throw a touchdown pass at all four levels of the field; it was his third time doing so, the most by any QB since 2016.
Chris Godwin caught 10 passes for 155 yards, his best showing of the year.
Five different Buccaneers wide receivers recorded at least 40 receiving yards.
It was Mayfield's third career 4-TD, 0-INT game and first as a Buc, and only the fourth time he has thrown at least four touchdowns in a game.
The game gave Mayfield the second-most single-game yards and second-most single-game touchdowns of his career.
